definition: Percentage of leads correctly routed to appropriate next action
action_if_breached: 1. Review recent routing decisions 2. Check business rules configuration 3. Analyze scoring edge cases 4. Update routing logic if needed

definition: Number of commercial policy violations detected per day
action_if_breached: 1. Review blocked claims for pattern analysis 2. Update claim validation rules 3. Investigate LLM generation drift 4. Retrain content filters if needed

definition: Percentage of leads using deterministic templates instead of LLM
action_if_breached: 1. Check LLM provider status 2. Verify API credentials and quotas 3. Test LLM connectivity 4. Escalate to provider if needed

definition: Percentage of DNS/website checks timing out
action_if_breached: 1. Check internet connectivity 2. Monitor network latency 3. Review timeout thresholds 4. Consider temporary timeout extension

definition: Percentage of quarantined leads manually overridden as legitimate
action_if_breached: 1. Review quarantine patterns 2. Analyze false positive cases 3. Adjust detection sensitivity 4. Update competitor domain lists

definition: Percentage of generated drafts edited before approval
action_if_breached: 1. Review common edit patterns 2. Analyze draft quality issues 3. Improve LLM prompting 4. Update template fallbacks

definition: 95th percentile processing time across all leads
action_if_breached: 1. Check system resource usage 2. Monitor external service latency 3. Identify performance bottlenecks 4. Scale resources if needed

definition: Time from lead processing to human approval decision
action_if_breached: 1. Check SDR workload distribution 2. Review approval queue backlog 3. Assess training needs 4. Consider workflow optimization

definition: Percentage of processed leads with complete audit trail
action_if_breached: 1. Check audit database connectivity 2. Verify logging configuration 3. Investigate missing events 4. Ensure regulatory compliance

definition: Percentage of leads failing due to system errors
action_if_breached: 1. Check application logs for errors 2. Verify database connectivity 3. Monitor system resources 4. Restart services if needed

definition: Number of security violations or bypass attempts per day
action_if_breached: 1. Investigate security event details 2. Review access patterns 3. Check for coordinated attacks 4. Update security measures

definition: Percentage of processed leads with complete enrichment data
action_if_breached: 1. Check enrichment data sources 2. Review synthetic dataset coverage 3. Identify missing company types 4. Update data sources
